_comment: Wordmark modules. `tex` is the typeset form (kept so the mark has an authority to point at); `plain` is what the app draws — the same expression without LaTeX commands, because the field's wordmark is composed from glyphs rather than typeset, so it costs no library and no reflow. Themes opt in by naming a wordmark in their `brand` field: a theme without one is quiet, not broken.

qubitick.name: QuBit·Tick
qubitick.note: The product, written the way the product is written: a qubit that ticks. Nested application, one level per surface — container, module, input, state.

plain.name: QuBit·Tick (plain)
plain.note: For surfaces too small to read the nested form.
